newsitem.title: FRANCE: French anti-racist movement sues over murder call.
newsitem.headline: French anti-racist movement sues over murder call.

text.p: France's anti-racism movement MRAP said on Friday it was seeking legal action against a group which issued a pamphlet calling for the death of its president.
A copy of the pamphlet released by MRAP said: "Let Allah give those Moslems who betray him...such as MRAP President Mouloud Aounit the fate of the sheep on the Aid al-Kebir."
MRAP said it had asked Paris' state prosecutor to prosecute the authors of the pamphlet, which was signed by a so-called Franco-Islamic Liberation Committee.
Its statement was backed by several dozen prominent people including the widow of president Franois Mitterrand, Danielle, and Louis Viannet, head of the Communist CGT trade union.
MRAP said it had reported the pamphlet to the Interior and Justice ministries but Aounit had not been given any protection.

It said the pamphlet was being distributed by Radio Islam, a radio station based in Stockholm, and the Paris bookshop La Vieille Taupe which has come under fire for selling books questioning whether the World War Two Holocaust ever took place.
